This maize plot is small and rented, so I must be careful with money. I will buy one bag of NPK if I can manage it, because maize does not grow well here without fertilizer, and I will spread the small animal manure I have from my goats. I cannot afford improved seed from the agro-dealer, so I will plant seed I saved from last season. My daughter and I will do most of the work ourselves; maybe I call my neighbor for one or two days at planting.
